title: Lead Manufacturing Specialist - Prod Process and Equip
description:
At Arabelle Solutions, part of EDF Group, we’re proud to design services and solutions that are generating power not just for today and tomorrow but for generations to come.
  
  
You’ll work alongside passionate bright minds. We offer a broad range of opportunities for those eager to build tomorrow’s world.
  
  
We believe a supportive culture is key to reach common goals. Diversity and an inclusive mindset makes us and our business stronger.
  
  
Engineering associated with the manufacturing process. Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline. Functions with some autonomy but guided by established policies or review of end results.
  
  
The job allows modification of procedures and practices covering work as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability (quality, volume, timeliness etc.).
  
  
**Overall Target Of The Position**
Establish the detailed manufacturing processes of the job utilizing own experience and coordination with lead factories for implementing their best processes and practices. Drive the culture of continuous improvements and take lean initiatives.
  
  
Drive and coordinate the execution of Machine Shop operations, machining and assembly processes related to machining wing to wing with (SQDC)Zero deviation in Safety and Quality. Ensure alignment of different stakeholders to achieve OTD & shop Utilization.

* Define and finalize the manufacturing process in the form of MOPs & SOPs for every component of Turbine Casing well in advance to the start of production.
* Work out optimum handbook hours & plate requirements in detail for every project.
* Envisage requirement of project tools and tackles required for production and drive procurement for timely availability.
* Preparation of delivery lists for dispatch.
* Validation of MOP Hours and process steps with shop.
* Coordinate and support Shop Planner for project scheduling and outsourcing of process activities ensuring efficient utilization of resources.
* Identifies & resolves technical issues prior to the start and during the production processes.
* Provide NCR dispositions and coordinate with engineering as applicable and implement corrective actions in future jobs.
* Record the learnings and process improvements and sustain through continuous updation of manufacturing process.
* Usage of various quality and lean tools viz. VSM, PFMEA, 8D and 5S
* Empower and support shop engineers for process change suggestions and implementation.
* Drive new product qualification and prepare related documentation.
* Continuously improve manufacturing process
* Uses technical experience and analytical thinking. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own teams to arrive at decisions.
* Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. Explains information; developing skills to bring team members to consensus around topics within field.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* EHS and Lean
* On Time Delivery
* COPQ (Cost of Poor Quality) control
* New product qualification
* Root cause analysis & Risk assessment
* Process improvement

**Desired Skill Set**

* Excellent process engineering capabilities and analytical skills.
* Thorough knowledge of heavy machining and assembly processes, Know how of steam turbine is beneficial.
* Key machining process – CNC turning, Milling, boring, tooling, Job set up and inspection/quality method.
* Thorough understanding of Engineering Drawings, Standards and Specifications
* Strong EHS & quality focus
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to identify and implement cost reduction strategies based upon process improvements and experience.
* Ability to develop credibility with employees, manager, and peers
* High attention to detail and accuracy of every task and Anticipate the future risks or challenges in advance
* Vendor development skills for new products and processes.
* Demonstrated integrity – accept and adhere to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, and actions when dealing with others
* Resolves internal issues quickly to meet customer expectations
* Come up with the alternative approach while raising a problem or a challenge
* Able to work cross functional teams to generate customer solutions as the final goal.

**Required Qualifications**

* BE/BTech/Diploma in Mechanical /Production min 10 years of relevant experience – min 5-yearcore experience of process/method of heavy machining and assembly.

title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
Job Title: Quantity Surveyor – MEP
  
  
Location: Gandhinagar (Gujarat)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor – MEP to manage the commercial and quantity surveying activities for MEP works. The role will be responsible for quantity take-offs, cost estimation, tender evaluation, subcontractor management, measurement, variation assessment, interim valuations, and final accounts.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of MEP systems, construction contracts, cost control, and commercial management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and BOQs for MEP works, including:
  
  
HVAC and ventilation systems
  
  
Electrical systems
  
  
Plumbing and drainage
  
  
Fire fighting and fire alarm systems
  
  
ELV systems
  
  
BMS and other specialist MEP systems
  
  
Review drawings, specifications, scope of work, and contract documents.
  
  
Prepare cost estimates and budgets for MEP packages.
  
  
Review and evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations.
  
  
Prepare tender comparisons and commercial evaluations.
  
  
Measure completed MEP works and prepare interim payment applications/certificates.
  
  
Review subcontractor bills, invoices, and supporting documents.
  
  
Monitor project costs against approved budgets and identify cost deviations.
  
  
Evaluate variations, change orders, claims, and additional works.
  
  
Prepare variation quotations and maintain variation logs.
  
  
Assist in contract administration and commercial negotiations.
  
  
Prepare monthly cost reports and cash-flow forecasts.
  
  
Maintain accurate records of measurements, quantities, costs, and commitments.
  
  
Coordinate with project managers, engineers, consultants, procurement teams, and subcontractors.
  
  
Assist with preparation and settlement of subcontractor and supplier final accounts.
  
  
Identify potential commercial risks and recommend cost-saving measures.
  
  
Ensure commercial activities are carried out in accordance with contract requirements and company procedures.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
Professional certification in Quantity Surveying or Contracts Management is an advantage.
  
  
3–8 years of relevant experience in MEP quantity surveying/commercial management.
  
  
Experience in building construction, infrastructure, or MEP contracting is preferred.
  
  
At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!

title: Buyer, Procurement
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Buyer is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted material availability to support semiconductor manufacturing operations through effective execution of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) in SAP, procurement of MRO materials, supplier management, and inventory optimization. This role partners closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Stores, and Suppliers to proactively manage supply risks, expedite critical materials, and minimize manufacturing downtime.
  
  
This position requires flexibility in working hours to allow for communication and team participation with Global ADI Procurement Team. Buyer acts as point of contact for Procurement related assistance for our offices across ADI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and execute MRP to ensure timely replenishment of production and maintenance materials.
* Analyze demand, inventory levels, lead times, and supplier commitments to determine procurement actions.
* Manage purchase order creation, maintenance, reschedules, cancellations, and quantity adjustments.
* Monitor shortages and proactively mitigate supply risks impacting manufacturing operations and drive improved inventory health.
* Collaborate with Planning, Category management and Operations teams on demand changes and supply recovery plans.
* Manage procurement activities for repair and serviceable parts used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
* Prioritize and expedite critical tool-down requirements to minimize manufacturing downtime.
* Coordinate repair order processing, supplier repair status tracking, and return logistics.
* Monitor repair turnaround times (TAT) and drive continuous improvement with repair vendors.
* Work closely with Engineering, Equipment Maintenance, and Operations teams to support equipment reliability initiatives.
* Maintain visibility of open repair orders, aging repairs, and high-risk tool-down parts.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers to ensure delivery performance and responsiveness.
* Conduct regular supplier follow-up for acknowledgments, commitments, expedites, and recovery plans.
* Resolve supply, quality, and invoice-related issues through cross-functional collaboration.
* Support supplier performance monitoring and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist with sourcing alternatives

**Inventory & Cost Management**

* Monitor excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory and recommend corrective actions.
* Support inventory optimization initiatives while maintaining service level requirements.
* Participate in cost saving and productivity initiatives through process improvements and supplier engagement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Stores, and Accounts Payable teams.
* Communicate supply constraints, delivery risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Support site shutdowns, maintenance events & capacity expansions.
* Participate in operational reviews and provide procurement metrics and status updates.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 1-4 years of experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Materials Planning, or Manufacturing Operations.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

title: Lead Project Quality Manager
description:
The Project Quality Manager has independence and authority to manage quality and nuclear safety across the project and is the key quality interface with the Customer, manages the quality and nuclear safety activities across the entire execution chain of an integrated project.
   

  

 Project Quality manager will integral part of the project team and ensures that all quality and nuclear safety related requirements in the contract is fulfilled.
   

  

* Ensure alignment within the project framework on all customers contracted quality expectations.
* Define and implement a strategy, priorities, and an action plan to drive nuclear safety across the project. It needs to be in line with the organization’s overall strategy and priorities.
* Ensure that the nuclear safety culture is deployed within the project, support its assessment and training campaigns and / or any event to promote nuclear safety (e.g., nuclear safety moments).
* Ensure that ITNS\-item information and data are rigorously communicated into our internal documentation (e.g., ITPL etc.).
* Contribute to quotation / negotiation from a Quality and Nuclear Safety perspective (ITO)
* Analyze the project contractual requirements and translate them into a comprehensive project quality strategy via the PMF (Project Management File) and quality plans.
* Ensure project Quality induction to the entire project team.
* Chair the project quality kick off meeting to share issued Quality plans with the Customer for validation.
* Accountability for the ITPs (Inspection and Test Programs) and ensuring compliance with contract / customer expectations.
* Prepare and drive regular Project Quality Review (internal), Quality KPI of the Project (part of the bowler chart) and to report them to the Project Director and Quality Management.
* Represent Quality within the Project reviews with the Customer (external) and share remedy plans, as necessary.
* Establish surveillance strategy (e.g., training, audit), based on project risk assessment.
* Define and deploy appropriate governance with relevant project stakeholders to regularly follow\-up of project tracking.
* Coordinate resolution of complex Quality issues raised along project execution.
* Ensure plans are in place to demonstrate conformance to Technical Regulation and Standards (TRS), local regulation, and requirements (PED etc.). Follow\-up Product PQMs (internal manufacturing), Supplier Quality (external supply) during manufacturing phase and Site Quality Management during site execution.
* EOMR compilation and follow\-up to the Customer in a timely manner (in line with master time schedule)
* Coordinate preparation and ensure flawless execution of the Customer audits.
* Guide, train, support, and coach the Project team for using relevant quality tools.
* Support Project Management within the PEQ (Project Execution Quality) process.
* Support Project Management within the Customer Satisfaction process.
* Ensure the Non\-Conformance Report (NCR) governance and interface with customers.
* Ensures overall governance of Customer Inspections (notification, attendance, reporting, action tracking)
